title: Three Years and One Short Post
subtitle: 探索发现 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 探索发现（科学与技术·探索与前沿）
meta: 主题语境：探索发现（科学与技术·探索与前沿）　|　核心词汇：frontier　|　正文 348 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 frontier 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the surveyor ① crossed a frontier that no officer in the region would have named, and he said the crossing was the whole of the year. The ② frontier, meaning the border itself and not the river, ran three years and stayed unnamed in the book; a frontier, he said, is the only thing in a region that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ frontier in that region had the same short post beside it, and the ④ frontier at the far ridge, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A frontier, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; the surveyor said the naming is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the frontier was the whole of the matter, meaning the new field and not the border. The ⑥ frontier, meaning the new field and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; frontier, he said, is either something you cross or the only word that means both a border and a new field. He said the new field is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ frontier had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short post. The ⑧ frontier of the whole thing, the surveyor wrote in June, was one region and three years of naming; frontier, he said, is either the one at the far ridge or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ frontier I remember is the one named in the plan, which closed in 1974 and is still described as the quietest in the region. A ⑩ frontier, my mother said in 1976, is the only one that improves by being named; every frontier, she said, is a new field that has agreed to look like a border. She said the new field was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 边界；国境（指这一带每一道旁边的那一道）
B. n. 边界（指那一道本身，与界河相对）
C. 固定搭配：cross a frontier 越过一道边界
D. n. 边界（指留给孩子们的那一段）
E. n. 边界（抽象总称，指一个地区的划界之事）
F. n. 边界（指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一道）
G. n. （学科的）前沿；新领域（the frontier of science，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 前沿（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: crossed a frontier that no officer in the region would have named
The frontier, meaning the border itself and not the river
the frontier at the far ridge
the frontier was the whole of the matter
The frontier, meaning the new field
the frontier had become a line in a plan
The frontier of the whole thing
A frontier, my mother said in 1976

answers.why: cross a frontier 意为“越过一道边界”，1965 年那位测量员越过了一道这一带没有一位官员肯说出名字的边界。
frontier 意为“边界”，指那一道本身而不是界河，它经过了三年而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
frontier 意为“边界”，指这一带每一道旁边的那一道，每一道旁边都有同一根矮矮的界桩。
frontier 意为“边界”，指留给孩子们的那一段，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
frontier 意为“前沿、新领域”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这片新领域就是那件事的全部。
frontier 意为“前沿”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那道边界，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
frontier 意为“边界”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一道，到 1972 年这一道成了计划里的一行。
frontier 意为“边界”，测量员六月写道，整件事的划界之事是一个地区和三年的说出名字。
frontier 意为“边界”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一道，1974 年结束了，至今仍被说成这一带最安静的一道。
frontier 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，一道边界是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的东西。
